decisions.what: Normalize line endings by replacing CRLF with LF before converting remaining lone CR to LF.
decisions.why: This makes each CRLF sequence contribute exactly one line break while preserving existing LF and all other characters.

decisions.what: Use string replacements without stripping or splitting.
decisions.why: Preserves trailing newlines, whitespace, Unicode and other characters; strings are immutable, so the input is not mutated.

decisions.what: Use only the Python standard library and retain the public `normalize(text: str) -> str` signature.
decisions.why: Matches the task constraints and public API.
